column1: AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE AL HAJ S. M. M. HUSSAIN CHARITABLE

column2: TRUST AND TO PROVIDE FOR ALL MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR

column1: INCIDENTAL THERETO
WHEREAS a Trust called and known as Al Haj S. M. M.
Hussain Charitable Trust has heretofore been established in
the Year 1982 for the purpose of effectually carrying out the
objects for which it was established:
AND WHEREAS the Board of Trustees of the said Trust have
successfully  carried  out  and  transacted  the  several  objects
and matters for which it was established:
AND WHEREAS the said Board of Trustees has now applied
to be incorporated and it will be for the public advantage to
grant the said application.
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Al Haj S. M. M. Hussain

column1: Charitable Trust (Incorporation)  Act, No. 74 of 2009.

column2: From and after the date of commencement of this Act,

column1: such and so many persons as now are members of the Board
of Trustees of the Al Haj S. M. M. Hussain Charitable Trust
(hereinafter referred to as the “Trust”) or shall hereafter be
admitted as members of the Corporation hereby constituted
shall  be  a  body  corporate  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“Corporation”)  with  perpetual  succession,  under  the  name
and style of “the Al Haj S. M. M. Hussain Charitable Trust”
and by that name may sue and be sued with full power and
authority  to  have  and  use  a  common  seal  and  to  alter  the
same at its pleasure
